# Weekly Docker cleanup - removes stopped containers, unused images, networks and dangling volumes.
# This script is intended to be placed in /etc/cron.weekly and will run as root.
# It logs output via the system logger under the "docker-cleanup" tag.

PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

  logger -t docker-cleanup "docker command not found; skipping cleanup"
  exit 0
fi

# The -a flag removes all unused images (not just dangling ones).

exit ${RC}"}
